records: November 1 00:00 UTC is the FinishAfter eligibility time for the two 500M XRP escrow objects; no funds move solely because the clock passes. A validated EscrowFinish transaction is required. Do not label 1B XRP as released, circulating or sold before transaction evidence.

The prior 12-month 70% re-escrow / 30% net-outside pattern is a small historical sample and is not a forecast of the November release. The released XRP may be retained, re-escrowed, allocated or sold; destination disposition is unknown until transactions are traced.

Exchange-wallet attribution includes customer pooled custody and identified non-customer reserves. It is not an official proof of reserves, proprietary treasury, beneficial ownership or immediately tradable float.

XRP Insights' October 31 08:00 same-wallet snapshot reports Binance 2.78B XRP and +17.6M over 7 days, while other providers report different levels and movements. Without the exact wallet crosswalk and per-wallet historical balances, the 233.46M incident transfer cannot be reconciled to aggregate reserve changes.

The XRP Radar overview displays an unlabeled Binance +196.2M delta, while the dedicated same-wallet exchange page reports +17.6M over 7 days. The unlabeled delta is not assigned a horizon and is excluded from analysis.

The XRP supply JSON top-level asOf date is the oldest input across heterogeneous categories; category-specific timestamps show exchanges at October 31 08:00:57 UTC, escrow at 06:00 UTC and RLUSD at 08:01 UTC. Do not classify the entire file as stale or treat all categories as synchronized.

SBI VC Trade crypto-card rewards convert points monthly into the selected asset, including XRP. No XRP selection share, reward redemption volume, funding source, inventory-versus-market-sourcing method or incremental spot-buy amount is disclosed. Reward credits are not automatically new external capital.

SBI Ripple Asia's tokenized-deposit/deposit-backed digital-money work is a conceptual proof of concept using XRPL, MoneyTap and a token issuance platform. No production deployment, customer balance or settlement volume is established.

SBI VC Trade's RLUSD product page indicates Ethereum support while XRPL support is planned, with a 1M JPY customer/order limit. Do not confuse SBI's Ethereum RLUSD listing with global RLUSD issuance on XRPL.

Circle/ACI's Colombia collaboration is a USDC settlement demonstration using ACI Connetic and Bre-B. It publishes no live volume and makes no XRP integration claim. Its multi-rail design could complement or compete with XRPL; neither outcome is proven.

Ripple/Coinbase announced RLUSD access on Coinbase Prime, Exchange and Retail across XRPL, Base and Ethereum. Coinbase Global Exchange collateral support is future/announced, not a verified live collateral balance or current demand figure.

Coinbase's RLUSD partnership does not prove Circle/USDC replacement. Existing Circle distribution economics and Coinbase USDC balances remain material; actual post-listing substitution, issuer mix and conversion flows are unknown.

Coinbase contributed x402 to a vendor-neutral Linux Foundation foundation; T54 operates a separate XRPL facilitator. This is an indirect protocol relationship, not proof that Coinbase operates or directly integrated the T54 XRPL facilitator.

T54/XRPL AI Hub reports 14.77M volume and about $45.2K value settled, while xrpl.fi says its reproducible fingerprint cannot validate the facilitator's cumulative claim and reports a lower recent count. The cumulative count, asset split and external-versus-test activity are unresolved.

XRP ETF sources disagree by universe and date. XRP Insights' October 30 row is provisional with data_as_of October 29; Maketo reports October 30 -$496.5K across five funds and October 29 +$8.4M. Flows are not automatically net external capital, spot purchases or final holdings.

TradRadar reports $1.86B OI across seven exchanges while Alpha's all-venue heatmap reports $2.81B. Contract universes, conversion methods and aggregation scopes differ; do not average. Heatmap liquidation clusters are modelled, not observed account orders.

Binance's 12-hour PoR snapshot target converts to October 31 07:33 UTC and has elapsed; publication results were targeted by November 2. The approximately 34-hour phased withdrawal target converts to November 1 05:33 UTC, not October 31 05:33 UTC. No XRP-specific replenishment amount is disclosed.
PR #1413 and PR #1414 passed exact-head CI and fail-closed gates but remain draft/open/unmerged. Their proposed workflow and prediction changes are not active on main.

Main remains at 52ce593d and still contains active scheduled writers, broad scheduler dispatch, a manual merge queue capable of merging all eligible PRs, push-triggered external deployments and an unsafe Databricks token-input workflow until approved changes are merged.

The Pillars Consistency Check failed because GitHub App credentials were absent, Databricks returned HTTP 403 and the Hugging Face Space reported BUILD_ERROR. Secret values were not accessed; the provider permission/build root causes remain unresolved and must not be bypassed.

The hourly Autonomous Resolver creates issues for workflow failures and assigns unassigned issues/PRs. This is an existing scheduled mutation path; no external AI platform authentication or live collaboration is proven by assignments.

Full repository CI, complete dependency locking/vulnerability scanning and complete branch-protection details remain unverified. The available GitHub security-alert read path did not establish a clean vulnerability state.
Only ChatGPT and the GitHub connector are verified active. Claude, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, Codex, Hugging Face, Kaggle and Databricks remain unauthenticated and untested as live collaborators.

The exact context of 'actual capital' remains unresolved. ASK Coin's leading candidate remains Permission Coin ASK with Coinbase Embedded Wallet, but no direct XRP/XRPL integration is established. Camilla Stephenson's exact YouTube channel identity and exhaustive public-video inventory remain unresolved.

The Japanese SBIC candidate is Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd., separate from SBI Holdings. Its ChatGPT/Copilot seminar is educational, not evidence of an OpenAI partnership. The exact referent of 'ChatGPT SBIC' remains unresolved.

No directional XRP forecast is issued. The new escrow, exchange, ETF, derivatives, stablecoin, x402 and macro observations are not admitted as predictive features until point-in-time quality, independence, scope and out-of-sample tests pass.

SBI VC Trade's Accumulation Service is a direct recurring purchase mechanism for selected crypto-assets including XRP, but the XRP selection share, aggregate purchase volume and execution/source-of-inventory data are not disclosed; do not quantify actual XRP capital from the product description alone.

SBI's approximately JPY 610B VCTRADE/BITPOINT deposit balance and 1.922M March 2026 accounts are all-asset group-platform figures, not XRP-specific holdings or active XRP customers; the figures are dated April 29/March 2026.

SBI's statement that B2C2 connection increased SBI VC Trade daily trading volume tenfold is a historical company-reported comparison since 2020, not current XRP-specific market depth or an independently measured causal effect.
